basic_info.description: Rarely available 14th floor desirable 2BED/2BATH condo with expansive gorgeous City & Park Views. This modern, move-in ready impressive Pacific Heights corner property is situated perfectly on the quiet rear of bldg.  Boasts inviting open & bright living rm. dining area w/ multiple windows allowing for natural light. Updated chefs kitchen w/ abundance of cabinets SS appliances, quartz countertops & designer backsplash. Two generous sized bedrooms including Primary bedroom suite with sitting area, sliding glass doors to covered patio w/ alluring City Views, walk-in closet, additional closet area w/ Bosch W/ D, plus en-suite bath w/ tiled shower. Features new lighting, full guest bath, freshly painted interior, wood flooring, 1 car GRG parking, storage & 24 hour door person for security & packages. Amazingly convenient, sought-after loc. situated quietly in the bldg. with amazing views, 1 block to Lafayette Park, close to Whole Foods & minutes to most popular restaurants, shops & more!
